facts.fact: The Citizen reports Home Affairs gazetted draft amended regulations in terms of the Identification Act, 1997 (Act No. 68 of 1997) for comment until 6 June 2026, with access to identity information regulated under that Act (document published 2026-05-09, no other date given).

note: Draft regulations are not made rules, so no applied fact; the document does not say the Act itself provides for digital identity.
